title: Nice for foot stool with storage.
text: Nice for foot stool with storage.. This is a cute storage cube. The top is cushy but I dont recommend an adult to sit on it. It is sturdy for storage and as  foot stool.  You pop open the bottom part , then place a piece that comes with it to help hold the shape of the square. The lid stays on pretty well. Easy to take off. Looks like real black leather.
